notes: Added complete story set for FEAT-1 covering schema, core logic, API, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Core Provider Search Logic (Vector + Taxonomy Fallback)
Expose Provider Search via Tool Router API

FEAT-1-STORY-7.title: Provider Search Request/Response Schema Definition
FEAT-1-STORY-7.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, filters) and outputs (ranked providers, metadata, fallback indicators) to enforce strict contracts across the system.

FEAT-1-STORY-8.title: Core Provider Search Logic (Vector + Taxonomy Fallback)
FEAT-1-STORY-8.description: Implement multi-stage provider search using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding queries, with deterministic taxonomy fallback using NUCC codes when vector confidence is low, including location filtering (state/city/county).

FEAT-1-STORY-9.title: Expose Provider Search via Tool Router API
FEAT-1-STORY-9.description: Integrate provider search capability into the tool_router with allowlisted access, ensuring validated inputs, proper tool dispatch, and compatibility with the conversational agent tool-use loop.

FEAT-1-STORY-10.title: Provider Search Testing Suite
FEAT-1-STORY-10.description: Develop unit and integration tests for provider search including vector query execution, taxonomy fallback behavior, location filtering accuracy, and schema validation.
FEAT-1-STORY-10.evidence: GAP: No existing provider_search test file; must create tests aligned with provider_search_service behavior

FEAT-1-STORY-11.title: End-to-End Integration with FindCare Facade
FEAT-1-STORY-11.description: Wire provider search service into find_care_facade to support conversational queries, ensuring specialty extraction, search execution, and formatted response delivery through the facade layer.
